_comments.chromeUserDataDir: Persistent Chrome user-data-dir signed into your-account@example.com. Override with env SHEET_WRITER_CHROME_USER_DATA_DIR.
_comments.chromeProfile: Profile directory name inside the user-data-dir (passed as --profile-directory). Override with env SHEET_WRITER_CHROME_PROFILE.
_comments.channel: Playwright browser channel; 'chrome' uses the operator's installed Google Chrome (required so the signed-in profile is honored).
_comments.headless: MUST be false: launchPersistentContext against a real signed-in profile needs a headed window, and Sheets clipboard paste depends on a focused, rendered grid.
